Who Will Succeed Mary Barra as GM’s Next CEO? A Look at Three Candidates

America’s largest automaker is also looking externally for its next leader

By

The search is on for the successor to Mary Barra, General Motors’ GM -0.46 % decrease; down pointing triangle longtime leader.

GM’s board has hired a search firm to prospect for outside contenders, but inside the automaker there are a few potential contenders. The next chief takes over an industrial juggernaut navigating tariff headwinds, fierce global competition and an uneven shift to electric and self-driving vehicles.
